functions.name: search-employees
functions.description: Find employees by profile-value, presence, date-range and custom-field criteria.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation bound to the same criteria and connection.

criteria.description: AND-joined employee criteria; alternatives within values are OR-joined.

after.description: Exclusive lower bound: YYYY-MM-DD for dates, RFC 3339 with offset for instants.

before.description: Exclusive upper bound, using the same representation as after.

values.description: OR alternatives: text, identifier strings or calendar dates according to the selected field.

items.description: A text value, identifier string or calendar date for the selected field.

operator.description: Match supplied alternatives, test presence, or use exclusive date/time bounds.

customFieldId.description: Permanent custom-field ID; required only when field is customField.

FunctionInput_greenhouse_onboarding_sear.description: Employee search criteria and bounded pagination.

items.description: One matching page in provider order.

nextCursor.description: Next-page token, omitted when hasNextPage is false.

FunctionOutput_greenhouse_onboarding_sea.description: One matching employee page and its optional continuation.

tags.instructions: Use this for matching criteria, including missing values. Use `list-employees` for directory browsing or `get-employee` for details. Keep criteria unchanged when passing nextCursor as cursor. Limit is 1–25, default 25.

functions.name: terminate-employee
functions.description: Set an employee's employment status to Terminated together with a termination calendar date, immediately or for a future date.

employeeId.description: Employee identifier accepted by the mutation.

dateOfTermination.description: Termination calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD; retains local calendar meaning.

FunctionInput_greenhouse_onboarding_term.description: Employee and termination calendar date to submit together.

employmentStatus.description: Provider-reported employment state after the request.

FunctionOutput_greenhouse_onboarding_ter.description: Employee state reported by the termination mutation.

tags.instructions: Use employeeId from `list-employees`. This changes employment lifecycle state. A past date requests immediate termination; a future date schedules it. Inspect with `get-employee` before repeating an uncertain call. Use `update-employee` for ordinary profile edits.

functions.name: update-department
functions.description: Partially change a department's name or external identifier.

name.description: Replacement name; empty string sent literally.

externalId.description: Replacement external identifier, or null to clear.

changes.description: Partial fields to change; at least one required.

FunctionInput_greenhouse_onboarding_upda.description: The department to update and the supplied replacement fields.

FunctionOutput_greenhouse_onboarding_upd.description: The updated department reported by Greenhouse Onboarding.

tags.instructions: Get departmentId from `list-departments`. Omit fields to preserve them; null requests clearing externalId. Use `delete-department` only to remove the resource.

functions.name: update-employee
functions.description: Partially modify an employee's profile and administrative employment fields.

salary.description: Provider salary text; no currency or numeric interpretation is assumed.

createdAt.description: Administrative creation-instant override with explicit offset.

updatedAt.description: Administrative update-instant override with explicit offset.

profileImageUrl.description: URL of an employee profile image, not encoded file content.

customFieldValues.description: Changes to specified numeric custom-field IDs only; [] is a no-op, value null requests clearing that field.

customFieldId.description: Numeric REST custom-field identifier from list-custom-fields.

items.description: A selected option as ordinary text.

additionalProperties.description: A structured component as ordinary text, or null.

value.description: Business value: ordinary text, selection array, structured string-valued object or null; implementation serializes by field type.

items.description: A change to one custom field.

dateOfTermination.description: Termination calendar date; use terminate-employee to set the terminated status together.

otherCriterionIds.description: Complete intended other-criteria membership; [] clears membership.

requiredFieldsCompletedAt.description: Completion instant with explicit UTC or numeric offset; precision must be preserved.

changes.description: Partial changes; omission preserves values. Null is allowed only for a custom value. Empty strings are literal empty text.

FunctionInput_greenhouse_onboarding_upda.description: Employee identifier and the profile or administrative fields to change.

id.description: Updated employee ID as a lossless string.

updatedAt.description: Provider-reported update instant normalized to UTC.

FunctionOutput_greenhouse_onboarding_upd.description: Provider acknowledgement of the employee update, not confirmation of secondary events.

tags.instructions: Obtain employeeId from `list-employees`. Supply only changes; omitted fields remain unchanged. Use `terminate-employee` for termination with its required date. Changing email changes sign-in identity. Use `get-employee` to inspect the profile afterward.

functions.name: update-location
functions.description: Partially change a location's name, address or external identifier.

name.description: Replacement name; empty string remains literal.

address.description: Address text, or null to clear.

externalId.description: External identifier, or null to clear.

FunctionInput_greenhouse_onboarding_upda.description: An existing location and the fields to change.

FunctionOutput_greenhouse_onboarding_upd.description: The updated location reported by the provider.

tags.instructions: Get locationId from `list-locations`. Omit fields to preserve them. Null requests clearing address/externalId; use `delete-location` only to remove the resource.

functions.name: update-pending-hire
functions.description: Partially modify pending-hire profile, source links and custom-field values.

customFieldValues.description: Only listed custom-field values are changed; [] is a no-op, individual null values request clearing.

additionalProperties.description: Structured field component text or null.

value.description: Ordinary text, selection array, structured string-valued object or null; encoded internally by field type.

changes.description: Partial changes; omission preserves, empty text is literal, scalar null is rejected.

FunctionInput_greenhouse_onboarding_upda.description: Pending hire and partial profile, source-link, or custom-field changes.

FunctionOutput_greenhouse_onboarding_upd.description: Updated pending-hire identifier and provider update instant when available.

tags.instructions: Get pendingHireId from `list-pending-hires`. Omit fields to leave them unchanged. Custom-field IDs here are numeric REST IDs from `list-custom-fields`. Use `delete-pending-hire` only to remove the staging record.

functions.name: update-team
functions.description: Partially modify a team's category, lead, visibility or descriptive fields.

location.description: Location text, or null to clear.

teamLeadId.description: Lead employee ID; null is not supported by the documented write schema.

description.description: Description text, or null to clear.

changes.description: Partial modification; omission preserves fields, null clears description/location, empty strings remain literal.

FunctionInput_greenhouse_onboarding_upda.description: Identify one team and supply only the fields to modify.

FunctionOutput_greenhouse_onboarding_upd.description: Updated team identifier and provider update instant when available.

tags.instructions: Obtain teamId from `list-teams` and category IDs from `list-team-categories`. Omit fields to preserve them. Null clears description or location; use `batch-update-teams` for multiple targets.
